_comment: Leagues to pull for the Fantasy section of the website. Set enabled=false to skip one. Sleeper league_ids are the long numeric string from the Sleeper URL (sleeper.com/leagues/<id>); they CHANGE every season, so re-run ffscrapr::sleeper_userleagues('wadepfuller', season) to refresh them each year. market_format must be one of the FORMATS keys in export_fantasy.R (dynasty_sf, dynasty_1qb, redraft_sf, redraft_ppr, redraft_half, redraft_std). lineup blocks are derived from ff_starter_positions(). scoring is the league's own reception value (ppr|half|std) and drives the depth-aware power model; it is independent of market_format, which only controls which trade-value board the league is compared against.

leagues.label: No Fun League
leagues._note: 12-team dynasty, 1QB, 33-man rosters, IDP (DL/LB/DB) + K. The weekly model only projects QB/RB/WR/TE, so IDP and K slots are not optimized.

leagues.label: Kansas Keepers League
leagues._note: 14-team keeper, 1QB, has a DEF slot (DST streaming applies).

leagues.label: Tack 2025
leagues._note: League deleted on Sleeper (rosters endpoint 404s) — disabled.

leagues.label: #SFB16 San Francisco
leagues._note: Scott Fish Bowl: 12-team, 2QB/SF, 20-man rosters, all-flex lineup (every position min 0, 10 offensive starters, max 2 QB).

leagues.label: SF Fantasy
leagues._note: ESPN, 12-team redraft, half PPR. Starters 1QB/2RB/2WR/1TE/1FLEX + K and D/ST, 7 BE + 1 IR. Wade is team id 5 (named "Gruden's Grinders" as of 2026-08-28; ESPN team names change freely, the id does not). Private league - needs espn_s2/SWID via shared/espn.R. K is not projected by the weekly model and D/ST is handled by the DST streamer, so neither appears in the lineup block below. New league for 2026, so history_seasons=0 - asking ESPN for 2025 standings returns 401, not an empty result.
